author: freeCodeCamp.org
description:
Learn the core fundamentals of OpenAI Codex, from setting up scheduled automations and custom skills to mastering Plan and Go modes. Follow along step-by-step as we build, test, and deploy a voice-controlled Flappy Bird game built entirely with Codex.

Course developed by @SkyrocketingTech 

❤️ Support for this channel comes from our friends at Scrimba – the coding platform that's reinvented interactive learning: https://scrimba.com/freecodecamp

⭐️ Chapters ⭐️
- 00:00 Introduction to OpenAI Codex
- 01:17 Download & Installation
- 02:08 Pricing & Plan Options
- 03:27 Left Sidebar Overview & Scheduled Automations
- 05:08 Projects vs. Chats
- 07:09 Integrations & Plugins (Supabase, Notion, Gmail)
- 09:21 Updated Interface & ChatGPT Desktop Integration
- 11:08 GitHub Pull Requests in Codex
- 12:07 Deploying Web Apps with Sites
- 14:02 Main Work Area: Voice Input, Models & Speed Settings
- 17:06 Permission Levels & Context Inputs
- 19:13 Commands, Codex Pet & Reusable Skills
- 26:04 Plan
title: OpenAI Codex Crash Course – Build & Deploy Apps with Autonomous AI
